events.factual_description: Blue Note Place presents “three blind mice presents: Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio meets DJ Tatsuo Sunaga” on Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Doors open at 18:00 and the approximately 60-minute live performance begins at 19:00, with an approximately 30-minute intermission and no audience turnover. The announced lineup is Tsuyoshi Yamamoto on piano, Hiroshi Kagawa on bass, Toshio Osumi on drums and Tatsuo Sunaga on DJ. The venue lists ¥5,500 for first-floor seating and ¥4,500 for second-floor seating, plus a minimum one-order requirement per guest.

en.why_it_matters: This is the Yamamoto thread folding back through the records that made it legible: the working trio brings Three Blind Mice repertoire into the room while Tatsuo Sunaga treats the label as living material rather than a museum shelf. The friction between Yamamoto’s blues-heavy touch and Sunaga’s selector logic gives the night a concrete shape beyond another trio booking.
en.trip_verdict: If Tokyo is already in play, actively make room for this one; the live/DJ exchange and explicit Three Blind Mice frame make it a sharper choice than a routine club date. It is worth anchoring an Ebisu evening around, though not enough on its own to reroute an international trip.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí el hilo de Yamamoto vuelve a los discos que lo hicieron reconocible: el trío activo lleva el repertorio de Three Blind Mice a la sala mientras Tatsuo Sunaga trata el sello como material vivo y no como pieza de museo. La fricción entre el toque cargado de blues de Yamamoto y la lógica de selector de Sunaga le da a la noche una forma concreta, más allá de otra fecha de trío.
es.trip_verdict: Si Tokio ya está en el itinerario, le haría espacio de manera activa; el cruce entre trío y DJ y el marco explícito de Three Blind Mice la vuelven una apuesta más precisa que una fecha habitual de club. Puede anclar una noche en Ebisu, aunque no justifica por sí sola desviar un viaje internacional.
